workflow.name: Marketing Auto
workflow.description: Marketing requests routed by the leader to the squad that does the work, then checked and reported back to the requester.

steps.instructions: Intake. Name the market (vn or intl) and the kind of work in your first comment. Route each part of the work as a sub-issue to Marketing Studio, Content Studio, Growth Lab or PR & Comms, with a brief, the market and the channel. Then move this request to in progress.

Routed. Wait for the routed parts. Check each part as it comes back against the market and the brief. A part that failed its gates goes back to its squad with the open problem. When every part is checked, move this request to in review.
A person checks the report and the parts, then moves the request to done. Nothing is published or sent without that person's approval.
